' Resolve preview paint from the actual IDE loader's parent-first inheritance chain.
' Read-only: no theme activation, browser CSS evaluation, paths or raw theme text in view snapshots.
Private Module InstalledThemeCatalog
    Public Function TCatalog(ByVal source As UpdateJson, ByVal windowsAccent As String) As UpdateJson
        Dim result As UpdateJson = JA(), theme As UpdateJson
        For Each theme In source.Member("themes").Items
            result.Push TEntry(theme, windowsAccent)
        Next
        Set TCatalog = result
    End Function
    Private Function TEntry(ByVal theme As UpdateJson, ByVal windowsAccent As String) As UpdateJson
        Dim entry As UpdateJson = JO(), name As String = JT(theme, "name"), mode As String = JT(theme, "mode")
        entry.Assign "name", JS(name)
        If mode = "light" Or mode = "dark" Then entry.Assign "mode", JS(mode)
        On Error GoTo Unavailable
        Dim values As Object = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary"), part As UpdateJson
        values.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
        If Len(JT(theme, "error")) = 0 Then
            For Each part In theme.Member("chain").Items: TParse part.Text, values: Next
        Else
            If InStr(1, JT(theme, "error"), "Recursive", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then UFail JT(theme, "error")
            ' Some IDE builds expose names but omit the original declaration text.
            ' Read only an exact matching theme file, never an arbitrary browser path.
            Dim visited As Object = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
            visited.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
            TReadChain name, values, visited, 0
        End If
        Dim palette As UpdateJson = JO()
        Dim background As String = TFirstPaint(values, "GeneralBackColor|GeneralPanelBackColor|CodePanelBackColor|MenuBackColor")
        Dim surface As String = TFirstPaint(values, "PanelBackground|DockContainerBackground|GeneralPanelBackColor|ToolbarBackground|GeneralBackColor")
        Dim foreground As String = TFirstPaint(values, "GeneralTextColor|MenuForeColor|PanelHeaderTextColor|ToolWindowBodyForeColor")
        ' AddinAccentBackColor is not required by native themes. Use their real accent or
        ' selection declarations, not the currently active IDE theme's computed palette.
        Dim accent As String = TFirstPaint(values, "AddinAccentBackColor|FindResultColor|FrontPageIconColor|DebugIntellisensePartialMatchColor|SelectedTextBackColor|ToolbarPreviewButtonColor")
        If Len(surface) = 0 Then surface = background
        If Len(accent) = 0 Then accent = foreground
        If Len(background) = 0 Or Len(surface) = 0 Or Len(foreground) = 0 Or Len(accent) = 0 Then UFail "Effective base theme colors are unavailable."
        palette.Assign "background", JS(background): palette.Assign "surface", JS(surface)
        palette.Assign "foreground", JS(foreground): palette.Assign "accent", JS(accent)
        TOptional palette, "titlebar", TPaint(values, "MenuBackColor")
        TOptional palette, "toolbar", TPaint(values, "ToolbarBackground")
        TOptional palette, "panel", surface
        TOptional palette, "editor", TPaint(values, "CodePanelBackColor")
        TOptional palette, "muted", TPaint(values, "GeneralSubTextColor")
        TOptional palette, "border", TFirstPaint(values, "AddinBorderColor|GeneralSubTextColor|GeneralTextColor")
        entry.Assign "preview", palette
        Set TEntry = entry: Exit Function
    Unavailable:
        entry.Assign "previewError", JS(Err.Description)
        Set TEntry = entry
    End Function
    Private Sub TOptional(ByVal palette As UpdateJson, ByVal key As String, ByVal value As String)
        If Len(value) > 0 Then palette.Assign key, JS(value)
    End Sub
    Private Sub TReadChain(ByVal name As String, ByVal values As Object, ByVal visited As Object, ByVal depth As Long)
        If depth > 32 Or visited.Exists(name) Then UFail "Recursive or excessive theme inheritance."
        If Len(name) = 0 Or Len(name) > 160 Or name = "." Or name = ".." Then UFail "Invalid installed theme name."
        Dim bad As Variant
        For Each bad In Split("\|/|:|*|?|<|>|" & Chr(34), "|")
            If InStr(name, CStr(bad)) > 0 Then UFail "Invalid installed theme filename."
        Next
        If InStr(name, "|") > 0 Then UFail "Invalid installed theme filename."
        visited.Item(name) = True
        Dim localPath As String = USafe(LCompilerRoot(), "themes/" & name & ".theme")
        Dim appRoot As String = Environ$("APPDATA"), userPath As String
        If Len(appRoot) = 0 Then UFail "Theme directory is unavailable."
        userPath = USafe(appRoot, "twinBASIC/themes/" & name & ".theme")
        Dim found As Boolean, body As String
        If UExists(localPath) Then
            If USize(localPath) > 1048576 Then UFail "Theme text is too large."
            body = UText(localPath): found = True
        End If
        If UExists(userPath) Then
            If USize(userPath) > 1048576 Then UFail "Theme text is too large."
            Dim userText As String = UText(userPath)
            If found And userText <> body Then UFail "Duplicate theme files require the IDE loader's effective text."
            body = userText: found = True
        End If
        If Not found Then UFail "The exact installed theme file could not be read."
        Dim declarations As Object = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
        declarations.CompareMode = vbTextCompare
        TParse body, declarations
        If declarations.Exists("inherits") Then
            Dim parent As String = Trim$(CStr(declarations.Item("inherits")))
            If Len(parent) > 0 Then TReadChain parent, values, visited, depth + 1
        End If
        Dim key As Variant
        For Each key In declarations.Keys
            values.Item(key) = declarations.Item(key)
        Next
    End Sub
    Private Sub TParse(ByVal text As String, ByVal values As Object)
        If Left$(text, 1) = ChrW$(&HFEFF&) Then text = Mid$(text, 2)
        Dim at As Long, finish As Long
        Do
            at = InStr(text, "/*"): If at = 0 Then Exit Do
            finish = InStr(at + 2, text, "*/")
            If finish = 0 Then UFail "Unterminated theme comment."
            text = Left$(text, at - 1) & Mid$(text, finish + 2)
        Loop
        ' Parse declarations independently of indentation, capitalization and line endings.
        ' Only the allowlisted paint keys are consumed below; no CSS is executed.
        Dim declaration As Variant
        For Each declaration In Split(text, ";")
            Dim line As String = Trim$(Replace(Replace(Replace(CStr(declaration), vbCr, ""), vbLf, ""), vbTab, " "))
            Dim separator As Long = InStr(line, ":")
            If separator > 1 Then
                Dim key As String = Trim$(Left$(line, separator - 1))
                Dim value As String = Trim$(Mid$(line, separator + 1))
                If Right$(LCase$(value), 10) = "!important" Then value = Trim$(Left$(value, Len(value) - 10))
                If Len(key) > 0 And Len(value) > 0 Then values.Item(key) = value
            End If
        Next
    End Sub
    Private Function TFirstPaint(ByVal values As Object, ByVal names As String) As String
        Dim name As Variant
        For Each name In Split(names, "|")
            Dim paint As String = TPaint(values, CStr(name))
            If Len(paint) > 0 Then Return paint
        Next
        Return ""
    End Function
    Private Function TPaint(ByVal values As Object, ByVal key As String, Optional ByVal depth As Long = 0) As String
        If depth > 16 Or Not values.Exists(key) Then Return ""
        Dim value As String = LCase$(Trim$(CStr(values.Item(key))))
        If Left$(value, 11) = "var(--theme" And Right$(value, 1) = ")" Then Return TPaint(values, Mid$(CStr(values.Item(key)), 12, Len(value) - 12), depth + 1)
        Dim hex As String = THex(value)
        If Len(hex) > 0 Then Return hex
        Select Case value
            Case "white": Return "#ffffff"
            Case "black": Return "#000000"
            Case "transparent": Return "#00000000"
        End Select
        If Left$(value, 4) <> "rgb(" And Left$(value, 5) <> "rgba(" Then Return ""
        If Right$(value, 1) <> ")" Then Return ""
        Dim start As Long = InStr(value, "("), fields() As String, i As Long, count As Long, n As Double, output As String = "#"
        value = Mid$(value, start + 1, Len(value) - start - 1)
        value = Replace(Replace(Replace(value, ",", " "), "/", " "), vbTab, " ")
        Do While InStr(value, "  ") > 0: value = Replace(value, "  ", " "): Loop
        fields = Split(Trim$(value), " "): count = UBound(fields) + 1
        If count <> 3 And count <> 4 Then Return ""
        For i = 0 To count - 1
            Dim token As String = fields(i), percent As Boolean = Right$(token, 1) = "%", j As Long, dots As Long
            If percent Then token = Left$(token, Len(token) - 1)
            If Len(token) = 0 Then Return ""
            dots = 0
            For j = 1 To Len(token)
                Dim ch As String = Mid$(token, j, 1)
                If ch = "." Then
                    dots = dots + 1: If dots > 1 Then Return ""
                ElseIf ch < "0" Or ch > "9" Then
                    Return ""
                End If
            Next
            If token = "." Then Return ""
            n = Val(token)
            If percent Then
                If n > 100 Then Return ""
                n = n * 255 / 100
            ElseIf i = 3 Then
                If n > 1 Then Return ""
                n = n * 255
            ElseIf n > 255 Then
                Return ""
            End If
            Dim rounded As Long = CLng(Fix(n + 0.5))
            output = output & Mid$("0123456789abcdef", (rounded \ 16) + 1, 1) & Mid$("0123456789abcdef", (rounded Mod 16) + 1, 1)
        Next
        Return output
    End Function
    Private Function THex(ByVal value As String) As String
        If Left$(value, 1) <> "#" Then Return ""
        Dim count As Long = Len(value) - 1, i As Long, result As String = "#"
        If count <> 3 And count <> 4 And count <> 6 And count <> 8 Then Return ""
        For i = 2 To Len(value)
            Dim ch As String = LCase$(Mid$(value, i, 1))
            If InStr("0123456789abcdef", ch) = 0 Then Return ""
            result = result & ch
            If count <= 4 Then result = result & ch
        Next
        Return result
    End Function
End Module
